scope: KV INT8 cache (separate blueprint 另項): per-token/per-head symmetric quantization of the paged KV store

design.layout: packed elem = int8[align8(head_dim)] + double scale; block_stride in doubles shrinks ~8x so kv_memory_bytes and the memory limit reflect the real footprint
design.quantize_on_write: kv_write computes scale=amax/127 (scale 0 = zero vector); round/clamp to int8
design.read_dispatch: KvSrc {fp | q8+scale}: cached entries read as int8 via dot_int8/axpy_int8 with the per-head scale folded into score/weight; current-step K/V stays fp64
design.prefix_cache: host snapshot stays fp64 — kv_read_head dequantizes on snapshot, kv_write re-quantizes on restore
design.gate: env XINGCHENG_CPP_KV_INT8 at load; governed Python layer owns the decision (same pattern as XINGCHENG_CPP_CUDA)

validation.tests: 36 passed, 2 skipped (3 new KV INT8 tests)

measured.logits_drift: 0.0 on 7-token prefill (prefill reads fp64 current-step; int8 only affects cached decode positions)
measured.generation: greedy token-exact vs fp64 on tiny model, incl. generate_batch and MoE
measured.memory: kv_memory_bytes 16384 -> 4096 on head_dim=8 toy (4x; ~7x at head_dim 64)
measured.prefix_cache: hit/partial-hit generation identical to cold engine under int8

notes: separate error budget from weight-only quantization per blueprint; int8 reads only affect cached positions (t < position_offset), so drift accumulates over decode length — long-context error profile belongs to the long-duration validation window
